sequenceReference.note: V12B2A-i added the second Alembic revision (0002_customer_records) and its tenant-owned table entirely inside db/, and explicitly declared that the JS oracle/contract/checker still described only the S1 runtime substrate and knew nothing about 0002 or customer_records. This is V12B2A-ii: it closes that declared drift in the JS substrate layer only.

goal: Update db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json, tools/check-kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.mjs and tests/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.test.mjs so the JS oracle understands Alembic head=0002_customer_records (chained onto baseline 0001_runtime_substrate) and the customer_records table, while keeping the S1 RUNTIME_TABLES list exactly [transactional_outbox, audit_log] and treating customer_records as a separate, explicitly named domain table rather than folding it into the runtime-substrate concept.
nonGoals: no db/schema.py, migrations.py or Alembic revision change (owned by V12B2A-i, already GREEN)
no FastAPI, Django, ASGI, Uvicorn or Hypercorn delivery code
no readiness, release, deploy or product-ready claim
no broad rewrite of the S1 oracle beyond what acknowledging 0002 and customer_records requires
RUNTIME_TABLES stays exactly [transactional_outbox, audit_log]; customer_records is never added to it

scopeResolution.note: The oracle's PRODUCTION_MODULES, HEAD_REVISION and productionSurface.revisionCount hard-coded a single-revision world (0001 only). This package introduces BASE_REVISION (0001, still the baseline with no predecessor) alongside HEAD_REVISION (now 0002, chained onto the baseline via down_revision), moves revisionCount from 1 to 2, and adds a new CUSTOMER_DOMAIN_TABLES constant (['customer_records']) that is checked against the 0002 revision file's source, kept structurally distinct from PHYSICAL_RUNTIME_TABLES so the S1 substrate's own two-table shape is never diluted by a business table.
scopeResolution.modelChoice: customer_records is represented as a sibling domain-table concept, not folded into RUNTIME_TABLES, because the S1 contract's nonGoals and scope.runtimeTablesNote already state the substrate owns no business or domain table; silently adding customer_records to RUNTIME_TABLES would make that historical claim false. Declaring it separately is the least misleading model.

red.note: Before this package: 21 assertion failures, all stemming from the oracle still declaring headRevision=0001_runtime_substrate, revisionCount=1 and a single-file PRODUCTION_MODULES/REVISIONS_DIR listing, while the working tree (from V12B2A-i, base commit 2b028db) already carries two revision files and HEAD_REVISION=0002_customer_records in migrations.py. Representative findings: production-surface-drift:headRevision, production-surface-drift:revisionCount, production-surface-drift:modules, revision-count:2:0001_runtime_substrate.py,0002_customer_records.py, and a CLI run failing closed with the same three production-surface-drift findings.

green.results: kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.test.mjs: all tests pass; npm run check: exits zero

acceptance.twoRevisionsAcknowledged: HEAD_REVISION='0002_customer_records', BASE_REVISION='0001_runtime_substrate', productionSurface.revisionCount=2, PRODUCTION_MODULES lists both revision files
acceptance.chainVerified: checkSourceCrossBinding confirms 0001 still has down_revision=None (baseline) and 0002's down_revision=0001_runtime_substrate (head chains directly onto the baseline)
acceptance.runtimeTablesUnchanged: RUNTIME_TABLES / PHYSICAL_RUNTIME_TABLES stays exactly [transactional_outbox, audit_log]; the S1 contract's runtimeTablesNote and nonGoals are untouched
acceptance.customerTableDeclaredSeparately: new CUSTOMER_DOMAIN_TABLES=['customer_records'] constant, checked against 0002's source, never merged into RUNTIME_TABLES/PHYSICAL_RUNTIME_TABLES
acceptance.forbiddenPromisesStillEnforced: the exactly-once promise ban and the generic domain/business-table ban in the behavioural contract are unchanged and still fire on an invented table; customer_records is explicitly named as the exception the contract itself now declares, not a silent hole in the ban
acceptance.contractModulesUpdated: db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json productionSurface.modules gains the 0002 revision file entry; headRevision and revisionCount match the checker's constants

rollback.trigger: the oracle's revision count, head revision, or customer-table declaration drifts from the actual db/ source, or the S1 RUNTIME_TABLES list is found to have been diluted
rollback.action: revert db/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.json, tools/check-kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.mjs and tests/kernel-runtime-substrate-s1.test.mjs, and this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry, as one shard; this is a JS-only revert and touches nothing under db/metaframer_kernel_db
rollback.blastRadius: JS oracle/contract/checker/test layer only; no production Python module, migration or table is touched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none: this package changes no schema and runs no migration

capabilityDelta: the JS-side governance checker now agrees with the PostgreSQL schema V12B2A-i already shipped; no new runtime capability is added and no adapter yet writes to customer_records

userJourney.before: Veritabanı tarafında (Python/Alembic) müşteri tablosu zaten vardı, ama depoyu denetleyen JS oracle/kontrol dosyası hâlâ eski dünyayı biliyordu: tek Alembic revizyonu, müşteri tablosundan haberi yok. `node --test` ve `npm run check` bu tutarsızlık yüzünden kırmızıydı.
userJourney.after: JS oracle artık iki Alembic revizyonunu (0001 taban, 0002 müşteri tablosu) ve customer_records tablosunun varlığını doğru şekilde biliyor ve doğruluyor. S1 çalışma zamanı alt yapısının kendi iki tablosu (transactional_outbox, audit_log) hâlâ değişmedi; müşteri tablosu ayrı ve açıkça adlandırılmış bir kavram olarak eklendi.
userJourney.kullaniciYolculugu: Depo denetim kontrolleri (npm run check, node --test) artık gerçek veritabanı şemasıyla tutarlı; ama customer.create isteğini gerçekten veritabanına yazan JS adaptör kodu (src/adapters/postgres-commit-adapter.mjs) ve tam CommitReceipt hâlâ yok.
userJourney.kalanEngel: V12B2B (adapter + CommitReceipt) tamamlanmadan müşteri kaydı uçtan uca çalışmaz; bu paket yalnızca denetim tutarlılığını sağlar.
